dataset_name: NWIC Indian Telemetry (CWPRS Rainfall & Maharashtra SW River Water Levels)
provider: National Water Informatics Centre (NWIC), Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India

cwprs_rainfall.location_relevance: Within pilot basin (Directly adjacent to Khadakwasla Dam reservoir in Haveli Tehsil, Pune)
cwprs_rainfall.actual_sampling_interval: 5 minutes (23,873 out of 24,211 steps are exactly 5.0 minutes)
cwprs_rainfall.measurement_type: Cumulative 24-hour rainfall bucket resetting at 08:30 AM IST (Standard Indian Meteorological reporting day)
cwprs_rainfall.extreme_value_assessment: The reported peak value of 145.6 mm on 25-07-2024 at 08:25 IST is a 24-hour CUMULATIVE rainfall total, NOT a 1-hour rainfall rate. At 08:35 IST the reading reset to 0.6 mm, confirming the standard 08:30 AM 24-hour bucket reset. The peak 5-minute increment was +0.8 mm.

maharashtra_sw_river_level.hydrological_relationship: Located on the mainstem Krishna River near Sangli/Miraj, over 200 km south of Pune. It does NOT measure Pune / Mula-Mutha river water levels.

files.product_type: Maharashtra SW River Water Level Telemetry (Ankali Bridge, Sangli)
